# Test fixtures

Real responses saved from public APIs, so tests run offline and repeatably.

| File | Source | Saved |
|---|---|---|
| `spot_hinta_today_and_day_forward_2026-11-24.json` | `GET https://api.spot-hinta.fi/TodayAndDayForward` (region FI) | 2026-11-24 ~21:50 Finnish time |

Prices are public Nordic day-ahead market data. Do not edit these files by hand; save a new
one instead, so each fixture stays a true copy of what the source returned.
